comment: Sketch1 on XY for Trim's drag (mitcad#2524): two free points that frame the view's fit (p1, p2); two horizontal lines from x = -25 to 25 at y = 10 and y = -10; and three vertical lines from y = -20 to 20 at x = -16, -4 and 12, each crossing both horizontal lines, so that the piece of each vertical line between y = -10 and 10 is bounded by two crossings.
